question: Four words are given, out of which only one word is spelt correct. Choose the correct spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"PUBLICLY"** means something that is done, said, or made known to people in general; in an open or public manner. (सार्वजनिक रूप से)

 
 
• **Example: **The company** publicly **announced its new policy on employee benefits.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **PUBLICLY**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **RECCOMMEND** (सिफारिश करना): Incorrect spelling of "recommend".

 
 
• **Example:** I recommend this restaurant for its excellent food and service.
 
 
 
• **SIEZE** (पकड़ना): Incorrect spelling of "seize".
 
 
• **Example:** The police were able to seize the contraband during the raid.
 
 
 
• **SECRETERY** (सचिव): Incorrect spelling of "secretary".
 
 
• **Example:** The secretary is responsible for managing the office schedule and correspondence.
